description: A picture that stays in view beside a list of features. Following the section being read is a port contract (ScrollSpy).

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A picture that stays in view while the feature descriptions scroll beside it. `active` marks the description
  that is current (the page follows the scroll; that is a port contract). Axes: mediaSide (end, start), item
  (plain, card), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

  export type FeatureStickyProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    features: Feature[];
    empty?: string;
    active?: string;
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    item?: "plain" | "card";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    features,
    empty = "",
    active = "",
    mediaSide = "end",
    item = "plain",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: FeatureStickyProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((features?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="layout-grid" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Grid cols="1-2" class="items-start gap-8" data-slot="sticky">
      <Box
        class={cn(
          "md:sticky md:top-8",
          (((mediaSide as string) === "start") ? "md:order-first" : "md:order-last")
        )}
        data-slot="sticky-media"
      >
        <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
      </Box>
      <Stack gap={(((density as string) === "compact") ? "4" : "8")} align="stretch" data-slot="items">
        {#each features as f (f.id)}
          <Stack
            gap="2"
            class={cn(
              (((item as string) === "card") ? "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6" : "py-4"),
              ((f.id === active) ? "inset-ring inset-ring-foreground" : "")
            )}
            aria-current={((f.id === active) ? "true" : undefined)}
            data-slot="item"
          >
            <LucideIcon name={f.icon} size={24} />
            <Title as={3} size="2xl" weight="bold">
              {f.title}
            </Title>
            <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {f.text}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        {/each}
      </Stack>
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
